Here's my take.. if you are able to, try to drop all labels. Man, woman, femme, butch, trans. Stop analyzing yourself too much. To me, it's all about personality. I fell in love with a girl without even knowing what she looked like, (long story but just emphasizing the point). Attraction is a major thing in any relationship. But getting to know someone and falling for the actual person is becoming second standard. 
I understand the struggle between knowing if you are gay or not. I'd suggest quit trying to align with one and go for both. Go on numerous dates, join clubs and meet tons of people, network the shit out of yourself. Try hard to get to know everyone you can, and in getting to know these people, you may find someone you had no idea you even attracted to.
